maddeler.e: رَاوٍ • (rāwin) (informal رَاوِي (rāwī), feminine رَاوِيَة (rāwiya), masculine plural رَاوُون (rāwūn), feminine plural رَاوِيَات (rāwiyāt))
maddeler.t: Derived from the active participle of رَوَى (rawā, “to narrate”).
